name: Texas Rangers Golf Club
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (2737), whose grid has the nines the other way round from the club (it follows the Korn Ferry Tour's order): the club's #1 is the 589-yard par 5 (18Birdies; GolfPass's own photo caption), as in OpenStreetMap's hole tags, so the nines are swapped here, handicaps with them. Men's ratings. Tees by total yards: Home Plate = Black, Third Base = Gold, Second Base = Silver, First Base = Bronze.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: the practice green by the clubhouse, and the practice range west of #1 and #2 and the short-game area south of it (five greens and eleven bunkers).
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it (fitted to the bunkers on sand).
